record.question: Full form of BSUP
record.explanation: Answer B: Basic Services to Urban Poor. BSUP expands to Basic Services to the Urban Poor, as the original 2009 government programme guidelines state. Omitting the article the in B does not change the programme identity; Poverty in A/C/D is incorrect. Historical/source note: Formal name Basic Services to the Urban Poor; B is the matching printed expansion. Reference: https://mohua.gov.in/upload/uploadfiles/files/17BSUP%20revised%20guidelines%202009.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
